workstreams.name: Waiting-time baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do patients wait at each of the three hospitals today, and how does that vary?
activities: Agree waiting-time definitions with the sponsor
Collect waiting-time data from operational records
Compute baseline waits for each hospital

workstreams.name: Patient pathway delays
workstreams.answers: At which steps of the patient pathway do waits build up, and at which hospitals?
activities: Interview staff who run each step of the patient pathway
Measure queue times at each step from operational data
Walk the pathway at each hospital to observe waits

workstreams.name: Causes of delay
workstreams.answers: Why do the delays occur, and do the causes differ between the three hospitals?
activities: Interview clinicians and administrative staff on delays
Test candidate causes against operational data

workstreams.name: Diagnostic synthesis
workstreams.answers: What is the current state of waiting times across the three hospitals, taken together?
activities: Combine baseline, pathway and cause findings
Test findings with the sponsor before the readout
Prepare the final readout for the sponsor
